devdoc.details: The signal policy names this contract as the intent arbitrator. It exposes only release, so the arbitrator's cancel and extend powers stay unused. Authorize it as a StakeVaultV2 controller and a NullifierRegistryV2 writer.

Paused(address).details: Emitted when the pause is triggered by `account`.

Unpaused(address).details: Emitted when the pause is lifted by `account`.

acceptOwnership().details: The new owner accepts the ownership transfer.

disputeNonPayment((bytes32,bytes32,bytes.details: Anyone may submit: the scan is bound to the deposit's payee and the award always goes to the depositor.

params._attestation: Signed scan for the released intent.

owner().details: Returns the address of the current owner.

paused().details: Returns true if the contract is paused, and false otherwise.

pendingOwner().details: Returns the address of the pending owner.

params._intentHash: Intent naming this contract as arbitrator.
params._releaseAmount: Deposit tokens to release; any rest returns to the deposit.

params._window: Seconds a release's bond stays locked.

setOperator(address,uint256).details: Revoking stops new releases only. Open releases keep their lock until dispute or maturity.

params._cap: Most stake the operator's open releases may hold locked.

transferOwnership(address).details: Starts the ownership transfer of the contract to a new account. Replaces the pending transfer if there is one. Can only be called by the current owner.

devdoc.title: BondedArbitrator

acknowledge(bytes32).notice: DEPOSITOR ONLY: Confirms the payment arrived and unlocks the bond before maturity.

bondOwnerOf(address).notice: Bond owner that authorized each operator.

disputeNonPayment((bytes32,bytes32,bytes.notice: Pays the depositor the unpaid share of the bond shown by a fresh attestor scan of the seller account.

disputeWindow(bytes32).notice: Dispute window per payment method; zero disables arbitrated release on that method.

getRelease(bytes32).notice: Returns an open release; all zero after dispute or settlement.

isBondOwner(address).notice: Stake owners governance allows to back releases.

lockId(bytes32).notice: Returns the StakeVaultV2 lock id that holds a release's bond.

operatorCap(address).notice: Most stake an operator's open releases may hold locked, set by its bond owner.

operatorLocked(address).notice: Stake currently locked by each operator's open releases.

pause().notice: GOVERNANCE ONLY: Stops new releases. Disputes, acknowledgements and settlement stay open.

release(bytes32,uint256,(uint64,uint256,.notice: OPERATOR ONLY: Pays the intent recipient now and locks the same amount of the bond owner's stake until the payment method's dispute window ends.

renounceOwnership().notice: Ownership renunciation is disabled so governance keeps the pause and rail switches.

setBondOwner(address,bool).notice: GOVERNANCE ONLY: Approves or removes a stake owner that may back releases.

setDisputeWindow(bytes32,uint64).notice: GOVERNANCE ONLY: Sets a payment method's dispute window; zero disables arbitrated release on it.

setNonPaymentVerifier(address).notice: GOVERNANCE ONLY: Replaces the scan verifier for future disputes.

setOperator(address,uint256).notice: BOND OWNER ONLY: Authorizes an operator to lock the caller's stake up to `_cap`; zero revokes it.

settle(bytes32[]).notice: Unlocks the bond of every listed release whose dispute window has ended.

userdoc.notice: OrchestratorV4 arbitrator that releases an intent only against locked stake. An operator releases funds to the intent recipient and locks the same amount of its bond owner's StakeVaultV2 stake for the payment method's dispute window. The depositor takes the share of that stake a signed scan of the seller account shows was never paid: all of it when nothing matching arrived, the shortfall when less arrived. Otherwise the stake unlocks at maturity, or earlier when the depositor confirms the payment.
